text:
Thanks for asking! I wish I had a faster option for you, but unfortunately there isn't one. 🌿

Express shipping ($14.95) isn't available for Zone 3, which covers addresses over 1,000 miles from our nearest greenhouse, so Standard (5-8 business days) is the only option at your location. There's no paid upgrade or other way to speed it up.

A couple of things can help you plan:

- **Order early in the week.** Live plants ship Monday-Wednesday only, and orders placed after 12 noon on Wednesday wait until the following Monday. Ordering Monday or Tuesday gets your plant on its way as soon as possible.
- **Keep an eye on your email.** You'll get a tracking email when your order ships (tracking can take up to 24 hours to update), and we'll email you if a weather hold is needed.

If you'd like help choosing a plant or have any other questions, I'm happy to help. Thanks again for reaching out to Leafy! 🌱
